articles.description: An Omani co-pilot attacked the captain of a flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv. Following the assault, he attempted to crash the aircraft into the Saudi desert. articles.title: Viral video captures truck going 'airborne' in deadly 14-vehicle Pennsylvania crash
articles.description: In Haverford Township, a tragic multi-vehicle crash unfolded as a pickup truck veered wildly, triggering a chain reaction involving fourteen cars. Sadly, the driver, a man in his 60s, was declared dead at the scene. Eight others suffered non-life threatening injuries. Authorities believe a medical emergency may have led to the driver's erratic behavior, as the crash coincided with bustling festival activities, allowing for a swift police response.

articles.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has said Tehran remains committed to both diplomacy and defending itself, warning that any renewed military confrontation would draw a stronger response. Speaking in Tehran on October 4, Araghchi said Iran remains ready to pursue what he called a “just and honourable solution” through diplomacy to end the war. He also highlighted recent meetings with neighbouring countries, particularly Gulf states, describing them as productive and friendly. Araghchi said Iran and its neighbours have begun a new trust-building process aimed at establishing peace, stability and security in the Persian Gulf through regional cooperation.
